title.en: OpenAI launches native image generation in ChatGPT, igniting the 'Ghibli-style' cultural phenomenon
title.zhHans: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 推出原生图像生成，引发"吉卜力风格"文化现象

summary.en: In March 2025, OpenAI released GPT Image, a native image generation model integrated directly into ChatGPT — replacing the separate DALL-E system. The model could render text accurately in images, understand complex visual prompts, and generate in multiple languages. On March 27, users discovered they could transform photos into Studio Ghibli animation style, triggering a global viral trend. The 'Ghibli Moment' became 2025's first major AI cultural phenomenon, sparking both delight and a renewed debate about AI-generated art and copyright.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 3 月，OpenAI 发布了 GPT Image，一个直接集成到 ChatGPT 中的原生图像生成模型——取代了独立的 DALL-E 系统。该模型能在图像中准确渲染文字、理解复杂的视觉提示、并生成多语言内容。3 月 27 日，用户发现可以将照片转换为吉卜力工作室动画风格，引发了全球病毒式传播。"吉卜力时刻"成为 2025 年第一个重大 AI 文化现象，既引发了欢乐也重新点燃了关于 AI 生成艺术和版权的辩论。

narrative.en: GPT Image represented a fundamental product integration: image generation was no longer a separate tool (as with DALL-E, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion) but a native capability inside ChatGPT. Users could describe, edit, and iterate on images in the same chat where they wrote code or analyzed documents. The model significantly improved on DALL-E 3: text rendering in images was legible for the first time; multilingual prompts worked reliably; and the model could precisely follow multi-object spatial layouts. The Ghibli-style trend began when social media users discovered that GPT Image could effortlessly replicate the distinctive aesthetic of Studio Ghibli films — the soft watercolor backgrounds, expressive character designs, and whimsical atmosphere of Hayao Miyazaki's animations. Within days, millions of Ghibli-style portraits flooded X, Instagram, and TikTok. The trend was so massive that it became a news story itself: CNN, Forbes, NPR, and The Guardian all covered it. It also sparked backlash: Hayao Miyazaki's 2016 comment that AI art was 'an insult to life itself' resurfaced; artists expressed concerns about style imitation; and the copyright implications of training on Ghibli films' aesthetics were debated. OpenAI framed the release as 'ChatGPT Images 2.0' in a later announcement, and the model's successor (gpt-image-2) was released later in 2025.
narrative.zhHans: GPT Image 代表了一个根本性的产品集成：图像生成不再是独立工具（如 DALL-E、Midjourney、Stable Diffusion），而是 ChatGPT 内部的本地化能力。用户可以在编写代码或分析文档的同一个聊天中描述、编辑和迭代图像。该模型在 DALL-E 3 的基础上显著改进：图像中的文字渲染首次变得清晰可辨；多语言提示可靠工作；并且模型能精确遵循多对象空间布局。吉卜力风格的趋势始于社交媒体用户发现 GPT Image 可以毫不费力地复制吉卜力工作室电影的独特美学——宫崎骏动画中柔和的水彩背景、富有表现力的角色设计和异想天开的氛围。几天之内，数百万张吉卜力风格的肖像淹没了 X、Instagram 和 TikTok。这一趋势如此庞大，以至于它本身成为了新闻故事：CNN、Forbes、NPR 和 The Guardian 都进行了报道。它也引发了反弹：宫崎骏 2016 年关于 AI 艺术是"对生命本身的侮辱"的评论重新浮出水面；艺术家对风格模仿表示担忧；以及在吉卜力电影美学上训练的版权含义引发了辩论。OpenAI 在后来的一篇公告中将这次发布称为"ChatGPT Images 2.0"，其继任者（gpt-image-2）于 2025 年晚些时候发布。

description.en: Integrated image generation into ChatGPT, making it available to hundreds of millions of users without needing separate tools. Multi-language support and accurate text rendering expanded practical utility.
description.zhHans: 将图像生成集成到 ChatGPT 中，使数亿用户无需独立工具即可使用。多语言支持和准确文字渲染扩展了实用价值。

description.en: Ghibli-style trend reignited copyright and ethical debates about AI training on artistic styles. Artists raised concerns about style imitation without consent or compensation.
description.zhHans: 吉卜力风格趋势重新点燃了关于 AI 在艺术风格上训练的版权和伦理辩论。艺术家对未经同意或补偿的风格模仿表示担忧。

text.en: OpenAI released native image generation in ChatGPT in March 2025. The Ghibli-style trend went globally viral on March 27, 2025.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2025 年 3 月在 ChatGPT 中发布了原生图像生成功能。吉卜力风格趋势于 2025 年 3 月 27 日全球病毒式传播。

sources.quote: A text-to-image variant of the GPT family, GPT Image is native to ChatGPT as ChatGPT Images. Released March 2025.
ChatGPT: Viral Studio Ghibli-style AI images showcase power – and copyright concerns – of update.
